lines.text: Many learners say: My cousin is married with a doctor.
Better: My cousin is married to a doctor.
To! She is married to my brother.

data.wrong: My cousin is married with a doctor.
data.right: My cousin is married to a doctor.

native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “My cousin is married with a doctor.”. O certo é “My cousin is married to a doctor.”. O “com” do português não vira “with” aqui. Ouça o Ama e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.

en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “My cousin is married with a doctor.”. The right way is “My cousin is married to a doctor.”. The Portuguese “com” does not become “with” here. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
